talk.jaymoskingdoms.sea_sites.skipper.0: Mind the rail. We sail round the pale stones, never over them. The Tideborn aboard won't have it, and won't say why.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.sea_sites.skipper.1: A long ship with no flag is nobody's friend. If you see one off a quiet coast, pick another coast.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.sea_sites.skipper.2: Welcome aboard. Touch nothing in the hold and we'll get on.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.sea_sites.hauler.0: Everything on this deck is spoken for. Talk to the skipper if you're buying.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.sea_sites.hauler.1: There's a church down there with its roof still on. Used to be a hill. She takes what she's owed.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.sea_sites.hauler.2: Saw a raft yesterday. One man, one pot, no land for a week either way. Waved like he owned the sea.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.sea_sites.fisher.0: On a flat day you can see a lamp burning down there. Nobody tends it. We don't drop a line near it.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.sea_sites.fisher.1: Pulled up a rib once, long as this boat. Whatever wore it, I'm glad I'm late.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.sea_sites.fisher.2: First shell of the day goes back over the side. Costs nothing, and the nets come up full.
I paid for a cabin and I got one. I did not pay to be told what's under the keel, and yet.
A Tideborn at my table went quiet the whole morning we crossed the columns. Asked her why. She changed tables.
Are you crew? No? Then you know as little as I do about when we arrive.
